newsitem.title: USA: Norfolk Southern closing Tenn assembly shop.
newsitem.headline: Norfolk Southern closing Tenn assembly shop.

text.p: Norfolk Southern Corp said Monday it plans to close its system assembly shop in Chattanooga, Tenn., affecting about 60 employees.
Norfolk Southern said it will not close its Chattanooga diesel shop or car shop.
Its two others system assembly shops, one in Chattanooga and the other in Roanoke, will remain open, it said.
The company said those two other shops were under utilized. One of them, the Roanoke Locomotive Shop, will take on the work that was being done at the Chattanooga facility.
Employees affected by the consolidation will be offered work at Roanoke or other positions within the company.
